effects.title: Parking: spaces avoided from what builders would provide anyway
effects.question: If builders provide a set number of spaces per home with no minimum (by transit access and building type), how many spaces does the reform really avoid?

added.formula: P10, P50, P90 of 2,000 seeded draws of the sum over counties of added units per county in each draw; per draw: baseline units x e x (spaces avoided x cost per space / value per new unit) x k + baseline units x site-yield gain x share of spaces avoided, summed over counties and structure types in each draw = 1,612 units, 3,564 units, 7,220 units

effect.name: change in added units, parking_provided_spaces, state
effect.formula: P10, P50, P90 of 2,000 paired draws of (variant added units minus benchmark added units), same seed = −42 units, 980 units, 2,710 units

$data.verify: Count the spaces built per home in the last few multifamily projects near transit and elsewhere; set them against the minimum the code required.
